pages.name: Phoenix
pages.text: A giant predatory bird of sun colours that circles the crater.

pages.title: Wild and reborn
pages.text: The wild Phoenix fires flaming balls at all who approach, and sleeps at night on a nest with a reward at the crater rim.$(br2)A wild one cannot be tamed. But from $(l:heatland/phoenix_ash)Ash$(/l) a calm one is reborn, and that one can be tamed with a $(item)Spirit Apple$() (1 in 3).

pages.title: Tamed
pages.text: It helps in combat, carries a chest (use a chest on it; open with Shift and an empty hand) and can be ridden. Its wings scorch the rider like a magma block: enable $(item)Icy Touch$().$(br2)It needs $(item)hot food$(): blaze powder, magma cream, a blaze rod or an ember. A hungry one flies back to the volcano.

pages.title: Wrath of God
pages.text: $(#B04A1F)Do not kill a wild Phoenix.$() Perun will notice the killer: $(l:heatland/perun)Wrath of God$(/l) hurts while you carry its feather.$(br2)Killing a tamed one is not seen by Perun.
